question: Where is restaurant found within 70 kilometers while moving toward Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center at the Permian Basin, Odessa, TX from I-20 Wildlife Preserve, Midland, TX?
sql: WITH origin_poi AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geom_centroid FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%I-20 Wildlife Preserve%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Midland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_poi AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geom_centroid FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Odessa%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ), -- Calculate the bearing from the origin to the destination path_bearing AS ( SELECT o.geom_centroid AS origin_centroid, d.geom_centroid AS destination_centroid, degrees(ST_Azimuth(o.geom_centroid, d.geom_centroid)) AS bearing_od FROM origin_poi o, destination_poi d ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, path_bearing pb WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' -- 1. The restaurant must be within 70 kilometers of the destination AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, pb.destination_centroid::geography, 70000) -- 2. The restaurant must be in the general direction from the origin to the destination. -- This is checked by ensuring the bearing from the origin to the restaurant -- is within a 45-degree angular range (90-degree total sector) of the -- bearing from the origin to the destination. AND LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(pb.origin_centroid, ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) - pb.bearing_od), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(pb.origin_centroid, ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) - pb.bearing_od) ) <= 45;
